create_flux_pipeline: create a FluxPipeline instance that composes text encoding, denoising, and decoding stages for image generation
calculate_shift: calculate a shift value based on image sequence length and linear interpolation parameters
prepare_mu: prepare the mu parameter for a batch by computing image sequence length from height and width
build_flux_pipeline_stages: build pipeline stages including input validation, text encoding, timestep preparation, latent preparation, denoising, and decoding
run_flux_generation: run a FluxPipeline with required text encoders, tokenizers, VAE, transformer, and scheduler modules for multimodal generation
